intentEvidence: This plugin enhances your audio recording experience in Obsidian by adding folder selection, audio source options, pause functionality, and multi-track recording.
motivation: The author built it to enhance the audio recording experience in Obsidian.
problem: The core audio recorder lacks advanced features like folder selection, input device configuration, pause functionality, and multi-track recording.
summary: An enhanced audio recording plugin for Obsidian that allows users to select input devices, choose storage folders, and record multiple tracks.
